name: Microgrid renewable-priority allocator
summary: Applies the selected resource priority when allocating a feasible active-power target.
description: Applies the selected resource priority when allocating a feasible active-power target. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Renewable availability and load” at the input and “Priority-based dispatch allocation” at the output. Priority remains subject to electrical operating limits.
